allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Joe Armstrong, an orphaned drifter with little respect for much other than martial arts, finds himself on an American Army base in the Philippines after a judge gives him a choice of enlistment or prison. On one of his first missions driving a convoy, his platoon is attacked by a group of rebels who try to steal the weapons the platoon is transporting and kidnap the base colonel's daughter.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When an ordinary convoy run erupts into a violent rebel ambush, how will an untested enlistee's martial arts skills reshape the fight?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Given a choice between prison and enlistment, a martial-arts-trained drifter joins an Army base in the Philippines. When rebels ambush his weapons convoy and target the colonel's daughter, he is forced into action.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, kinetic, and light, offering brisk 95-minute action that demands engaged attention without emotional strain.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Sam Firstenberg, this 1985 adventure delivers swift combat choreography and straightforward heroic thrills, making it ideal for high-energy viewing with friends.
